_comment: Same frame as the parchment master, scaled by exactly 2471/3703 = 1922/2880. scale converts THIS source's pixels into master pixels, so it is the reciprocal: 3703/2471 = 1.4985835 and 2880/1922 = 1.4984391. The two axes differ in the fifth decimal, so both are carried rather than one averaged figure. This is the sibling whose flat climate fills gave the master's registration a measurable objective in the first place (see the master's record).

record.notes: WH3 climate map - the IE sibling that paints every land region in a flat saturated fill, and therefore the only one with a land signal a threshold can measure. worldgen/parchment.painted_mask separates painted region from bare parchment on CHROMATICITY (r=R/(R+G+B), g=G/(R+G+B); parchment reference r=0.4436 g=0.3344; distance > 0.04), not on brightness - the paper runs the full luminance range because of its texture, stains and vignetting, so every brightness threshold cuts through the middle of it. This silhouette is the objective tools/fit_registration.py scores the whole family's placement against, which is what makes the IE registration measured rather than eyeballed. Contributes no boundaries: its fills erase the very lines the other siblings are read for. Retained as a terrain/biome input for S5.
